title: Xometry: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
author: The Motley Fool Team
description: Xometry announced its first GAAP-profitable quarter and reached a $1 billion annual revenue run rate. Q3 marketplace revenue grew 43% year-over-year to $238 million with 36% gross margin. The company is expanding enterprise adoption with 2,172 accounts spending over $50,000 annually (up 26% YoY) and plans to integrate its AI tools into Siemens Designcenter software for testing in early 2027, targeting the largely untapped $275 billion custom manufacturing market.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company achieved first GAAP profitability, strong 43% YoY marketplace revenue growth, expanding enterprise customer base with 26% YoY growth in high-value accounts, and strategic software integrations positioning it to capture market share in a largely digital-untapped $275 billion market.

title: Xometry (XMTR) Q3 Earnings and Revenues Surpass Estimates
author: Na
description: Xometry reported Q3 2026 earnings of $0.28 per share, beating consensus estimates by 47% and revenues of $252.44 million, up 40% year-over-year. The stock has gained 60.6% year-to-date but received a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating due to mixed estimate revisions. The Manufacturing - General Industrial industry ranks in the bottom 39% of sectors, which may limit near-term upside.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company significantly beat earnings expectations (+47.37% surprise) and revenue estimates (+7.05%), with strong year-to-date stock performance (+60.6%). However, positive sentiment is tempered by Hold rating and weak industry positioning.
Expected to report earnings with modest 6.2% year-over-year growth and 7.2% revenue growth. Consensus estimates slightly revised upward (0.3%), indicating stable but unexceptional expectations.

title: Gates Industrial (GTES) Q3 Earnings Top Estimates
author: Na
description: Gates Industrial reported Q3 2026 earnings of $0.47 per share, beating consensus estimates of $0.45, though revenues slightly missed expectations at $903.6 million. The company has outperformed the S&P 500 by 9.5% year-to-date. Despite favorable estimate revisions earning a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy), the stock's industry (Manufacturing - General Industrial) ranks in the bottom 36% of sectors, which could limit near-term upside.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company beat EPS consensus estimates (+4.44% surprise), demonstrated consistent earnings beat track record (4 of last 4 quarters), and stock has outperformed S&P 500 by 9.5% YTD. Favorable estimate revisions support Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating.

Company has not yet reported earnings for the quarter ended September 2026. While expected earnings growth of +72.7% YoY and revenue growth of +30.5% are strong, no actual results to evaluate. Consensus estimates unchanged over last 30 days suggests stable but unconfirmed outlook.

title: Xometry to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences
author: Na
description: Xometry, Inc. (NASDAQ: XMTR) announced that its management team will participate in two major investor conferences in September 2026: Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference on September 8 in San Francisco and Citi's 2026 Global TMT Conference on September 10 in New York City. The company will host a fireside chat at the Goldman Sachs event, with webcast and replay available on its investor relations website.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company is actively engaging with major institutional investors through high-profile conferences (Goldman Sachs and Citi), which indicates investor confidence and strong market positioning. This level of investor engagement typically reflects positive business momentum and growth trajectory.

title: Xometry Announces Pricing of Public Offering of Class A Common Stock
author: Na
description: Xometry, Inc. (NASDAQ: XMTR) announced the pricing of an underwritten public offering of 2,647,059 shares of Class A common stock at $85.00 per share, generating approximately $225.0 million in gross proceeds. The offering is expected to close on June 3, 2026, with net proceeds intended for working capital and general corporate purposes. J.P. Morgan and Goldman Sachs are serving as joint book-running managers.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company successfully priced a substantial $225 million public offering at $85 per share, demonstrating investor confidence and providing significant capital for growth and operations. The offering was well-structured with reputable underwriters (J.P. Morgan and Goldman Sachs), indicating strong market reception.
